market_data.continuous_rule: Databento volume-ranked front month, point-in-time mapping
market_data.roll_policy: no back-adjustment; reject any measured window whose instrument_id changes

calendar.bank_business_day: weekday excluding official Japanese national holidays and BOJ Dec-31 through Jan-3 closure
calendar.february_rule: do not invent day 30; study last business day separately
calendar.eom_rule: last Japanese bank business day of each month

fix.timezone_conversion: zoneinfo Asia/Tokyo to America/Chicago; never fixed offset

topstep.structural_result: all requested fix windows are inside permitted hours
topstep.exception_policy: require actual bars at every endpoint; never fill CME holiday closures

phase1b_gate: run only if event-study sign, approach-to-fix structure, subperiods, and placebo contrast are coherent

candidate_rules_if_gate_passes.pre_fix_central: short 6J; scheduled decision 09:30 JST, next-bar entry at 09:31 open, scheduled exit at 09:54 open before fixing
candidate_rules_if_gate_passes.post_fix_central: long 6J, scheduled 09:56 JST open entry, exit 30 minutes later
